name: Power over Poison
summary: At Thunder Bluff, a young Horde druid returns to claim the gift of Cure Poison. After healing poisoned gazelles near the Crossroads with herbal mixtures, the initiate faces Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.

sections.title: A Lesson in Suffering
sections.body: Before granting a druid the power to cleanse venom, the Cenarion Circle asks them to learn what affliction feels like. Dendrite Starblaze sends the novice to the Crossroads, where Tonga Runetotem has them gather ingredients for a salve. The druid treats poisoned gazelles of the Barrens by hand, without spiritual aid, and sees the struggle ordinary creatures face against natural and unnatural toxins.

sections.title: Return to the Elder Rise
sections.body: After the trial, Dendrite sends the initiate to Turak Runetotem, the grand druid trainer on Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise. Turak warns that strange, virulent poisons near the Crossroads threaten the plains' natural balance. He commends the initiate's grace under pressure and grants the spiritual art of curing poisons, placing Kalimdor's living creatures in their care.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The trial teaches a Horde druid to cure venom. After preparing remedies by hand to save suffering gazelles, the initiate returns to Turak Runetotem and learns Cure Poison through druidic communion.
Turak Runetotem lives atop the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. He resides in the tent and hollowed roosts where tauren druids commune and train.

faq.q: Who sends the druid back to Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze sends the druid back to Thunder Bluff after they heal wildlife near the Crossroads. The night elf druid of the Cenarion Circle is stationed in Moonglade.

faq.q: Why did the Cenarion Circle make the druid cure beasts manually first?
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze teaches the druid to understand the labor and limits involved in curing venom before wielding spiritual magic. Seeing afflicted creatures struggle teaches empathy and respect for nature's balance.

faq.q: What concerns Turak Runetotem about the Crossroads?
faq.answer: Turak warns that unnatural, aggressive venoms are reaching wildlife near the Crossroads. He sees this as a grave disruption to the land's balance that calls for vigilance.

faq.q: Is this quest available to Alliance druids?
faq.answer: Alliance druids take a parallel trial of the same name. Night elf initiates return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus instead of Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.

angles.text: As a druid, you join physical herbalism in Kalimdor with nature magic and gain the lasting power to purge toxins from allies.
As a tauren, you prove your dedication to the Cenarion Circle and keep the Earth Mother's wisdom alive on the Elder Rise.
As a member of the Horde, you help safeguard central Kalimdor's wild lands from unnatural corruption.
